description: Equal-weight mean of two frozen pretrained encoders with linear readouts: MAPA (last encoder layer, closed-form ridge; Tang et al. 2026) and DIVER-1 0.1s tiny (linear head; Han et al. 2025). Each member score is mapped through the empirical CDF of its own label-free validation scores before averaging. No additional pretraining; ridge penalty and DIVER early stopping chosen on the validation split. Design chosen on permitted non-evaluation sessions only.
author: Jake Hemmerle
